notes: 1st storey plan. Its two 1:500 scale bars disagree: the one under this plan gives 8.3 px/m (10 m = 84 px) and the one under the upper roof plan 12.25 px/m. Scale from the published site area (2,500 m²) over the plot outline (outer edge of the boundary planting, chamfered at the Haig Road / Seraya Lane corner, 337,049 px²): 11.61 px/m. This rules out the 8.3 px/m bar and is 5% below the 12.25 px/m bar; car park lots (about 28 px wide, 58 px long, i.e. 2.4 x 4.8 m at about 11.7-12 px/m) agree with the site-area scale. North point on this plan points straight up; the small key plan on the elevation chart draws north about 21° clockwise of up, so north is uncertain by about that much. Stack positions are transferred from the elevation chart's key plan (01-04 on the Seraya Lane side, 08-05 on the car park side) by matching its plot outline, so they are arranged, not labelled. Core at the grey lift core between the 1st-storey units 02 and 03.
